findings.message: The initial black-crown failure is fixed, but the forest still needs deeper material variation and stronger environmental integration to stop reading as a uniform tree wall.

The white shoreline cube is removed, but the opening remains a broad bare lawn with a flat water band and sparse foreground. Add terrain-conforming bank and layered low/mid vegetation, then retain a bridge-to-forest child-height traversal capture.
Scale the chosen trunk profile with each generated visual scale; fixed world-space contact was incorrect for 2.45–3.95x tree variation.
Use instantiated material and collider assertions rather than text-only path checks; live rendered evidence remains the acceptance authority.
